welcome.greeting: Hi! I'm Ralph. Can you help me learn how you're feeling?

language.title: Which language?
language.hint: Grown-ups: pick the language your child speaks best.

who.title: Hi grown-up! Who's here today?
who.name: Child's first name
who.parentModeNote: Under 4? You'll answer for them, and Ralph will help.

freeText.placeholder: A grown-up can type what they say…

parent.title: Grown-up: please check what {{name}} told Ralph
parent.maxTemp: Highest temperature (°C), if you measured it
parent.meds: Any medicine given? What and when?
parent.sleepy: Unusually sleepy or hard to wake?
parent.notes: Anything else the nurse should know?

waiting.title: Thanks, {{name}}! Let's hang out while we wait for the nurse.
waiting.subtitle: Play a game or just talk and rest with Ralph.
waiting.games: Pick a game below or chat with Ralph!
waiting.companionTitle: Don't feel like playing a game?
waiting.companionDesc: Just talk with Ralph about how you feel or your favourite hobbies — or rest quietly and Ralph will check on you every 12 minutes (unless muted).

goodbye.title: Bye, {{name}}! The nurse is ready for you.
goodbye.sticker: Here's a sticker for being so brave!

fireflyTap.title: Firefly Tap
fireflyTap.subtitle: Catch the glowing bugs for Ralph's lantern!
fireflyTap.cardDesc: Tap the glowing fireflies before they fly away to light up Ralph's lantern!
fireflyTap.instructions: Tap each glowing firefly before it flies away!
fireflyTap.doneSpeech: Woohoo! You caught {{count}} fireflies! My lantern is shining so bright. Thank you!

cyber.cardDesc: Connect the nodes to boot up the system, then switch colours as you count to break the firewall and earn a hacker badge!
cyber.bootDesc: Drag your finger (or tap) to connect the glowing nodes in order, from 1 to {{n}}.
cyber.bootDoneSpeech: Awesome! The system is booted. Now for the firewall: count up and switch colours every time!
cyber.firewallDesc: Every number is here twice, in two colours. Count up from 1 to {{n}}, switching colour every time. The other copies are traps!
cyber.doneSpeech: Boom! You broke the firewall! You earned a hacker badge!
cyber.timeUpSpeech: Time is up, but you got so far! Want to try again?

companion.title: Chat with Ralph
companion.opening: Hi {{name}}! We don't have to play any games. How are you feeling right now? Or we can chat about your favourite things!
companion.activeSub: Tell Ralph how you feel or chat about things you like!
companion.quietSub: Ralph is resting quietly next to you. Say anything to wake him, or he will check in soon.
companion.sleepingMsg: I'm resting right here with you. Tap or talk anytime!
companion.demoCheckinNow: Check in now ("Hey, how are you feeling now?")
companion.checkinLine: Hey, how are you feeling now?
companion.painScaleLabel: How much does it hurt right now? (optional)
companion.inputPlaceholder: Type or tap to talk to Ralph…
